requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity regarding 'switches' resolved by domain context. Requirement structured as a single functional requirement describing the capability of the routing device.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing device shall filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Ambiguity resolved: 'switches' interpreted as a noun (device) rather than a verb based on domain context.
Rephrased to clarify the subject (routing device) and the action (filtering).
